question: Should OpenClaw accept `AssembleResult.referenceContext` and the `reference-context` host capability as a public context-engine SDK contract now, require an experimental/internal seam first, or pause this implementation until the API/security direction is sponsored?
rationale: Automation can verify the patch shape and Codex contract, but cannot decide the permanent plugin SDK contract or prompt-authority boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Hold For API/Security Sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR blocked from merge until a maintainer explicitly chooses stable, experimental, internal, or rejected direction for the reference-context lane.

options.title: Accept The Stable SDK Lane
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally own the compatibility and authority-boundary risk and proceed with the new public field, capability, version gate, docs, and tests through normal merge gates.

options.title: Narrow To Experimental Or Internal
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps the Codex additionalContext projection proof while marking or hiding the plugin-facing API until the SDK contract is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Hold For API/Security Sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked from merge until a maintainer explicitly chooses stable, experimental, internal, or rejected direction for the reference-context lane.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice primarily concerns the context-engine API and host-capability contract where feature history points to this owner candidate.
